constraints.requirement: App mode does not prefix, clone or filter shared region states. Debug-only workflow aliases are explicitly marked and use shared editor/lifecycle regions.
Execution mode is explicit; no implicit default. Current implementation declares Debug.
Opening/closing buffer, pending and latency retain interval identity/kind. None extent implies no active interval phase.
No editor surface implies no active editor kind/field/role/workflow. Voice and keypad share the value/continuation model.
Focused surface is an open/opening registered surface in an ordered stack. Multiple surfaces can remain open; manual mic access remains available.
Closed summary has no invocation. Loading/error and empty successful data are distinct.
End confirmation retains original interval identity; replacement invalidates it without stopping the trip.
A complete PIN plus one OK submits once. No PIN review stage or second confirmation.
Sleeping accepts only Wake voice commands. Manual Commands access neither wakes recognition nor authorizes other voice commands.
A stable descending permutation of Trip/Total/Standard with tie priority in that order; derived rather than independently mutable.
Historical early start is distinct from currently before scheduled start. Overtime is after standard boundary. B-game requires target above 100%, missed target and performance still above 100%.
Confirmed/reverted operations have no outstanding waits. Only owned locks release; stale callbacks cannot mutate replacement/account/target.
Transitional and user-activated announcements follow their event/request owners, not repeated state-matching ticks.
Between trips, summary remains open. Spoken OK opens Voicepad when available; touch OK opens Numberpad. Cancel/Close dismisses without entry. Other valid commands retain the existing dismissal rule.

Raw credentials, unique identities, transcript text, numerical readings, exact goals and deadlines are payload. Boundary labels, ownership relations and ordered return/continuation paths determine behavioral state; relevant navigation history must not be omitted.
Do not treat arbitrary Cartesian products as valid. Reachability and transition coverage are separate from enumerating region vocabulary.

Main standard_time_component is trip-only and its label is Standard Time in every scope. Header edit remains available during a normal active trip, including Down/Break/Lunch; standalone breaks have no standard. Aggregate accounting is unchanged.

Goal-bar Remaining = trip standard minus node counted position. Standard is 0:00 at 100%; Current is 0:00 at counted trip standard. Elapsed uses counted trip time, without prior aggregate elapsed history. Current End Time retains the existing deadline readout.
Idle nodes use configured goals. Active aggregate nodes use inferred current-trip requirements. Every goal editor edits configured non-inferred values; Standard edits time, not 100%.

Missed labels disappear and goals exit right; all failed retains final goal at right on a zero-based scale. Elapsed color occupies the right segment; all-failed Overtime runs from Current to final failed goal. Down uses its configured color; Break/Lunch colors do not replace productive bar colors.

Circles are opaque and packed using radius plus half each computed stroke width. Borders touch without overlap; miss pulses expand inward. Ticks travel with nodes. Labels have independent collision packing and leaders. Times/percentages share preferred 16px sizing.

Circle, time, percentage, caption and name share one touch/click/keyboard action. Right triangle opens a single failed editor directly, or a configurable selector for multiple failures. Selector has no entry-origin memory; ordinary label opening supplies normal choices again.

Above-150 user goal input becomes 150 before UI feedback. Correction sentence precedes recalculation and later chain announcements. Speech-passive notice never takes command ownership; audio batching does not serialize independent command slots.

Drop-In shares rendering and configured-goal selection. Observer permissions remain unchanged; publisher Standard Time is read-only. Raw configured publisher attributes take precedence over inferred UI goal components.

Existing node movement, failure exit, fitting and reduced motion are implemented. Load/start/end choreography is specified in goal-bar.md but remains proposed; do not infer deployed animation states from the specification.

constraints.rule: Settings Action buttons Full/Compact reuses existing control identities and action eligibility. Left actions/right details and pinned Log center independently on clock. Numberpad is touch-only, takes visual viewport and suppresses mic presentation until close; recognition intent is preserved.

debug.effect: Spoken input opens shared Voicepad; button input opens shared Numberpad.

transitionPolicies.trigger: Ready on an active productive trip

observabilityGaps: The root interaction snapshot omits editor role/dirty state, break selection, scheduled preparation, startup and audio ownership phases. The inventory references their actual owners; future FSM work must expose them rather than infer eligibility from disabled buttons.
ModeMenu custom dates and Down Details create unnamed dialogs. Their selectors/creator owners are registered here; future runtime FSM work should give them stable surface IDs.
Domain labels include canonical derived boundary classes as well as literal runtime enums. No claim is made that every combined state is reachable or every transition has been tested.
New custom callback editor sources, surfaces and providers require explicit inventory registration.
Numerical equality/ties are represented by independent goal/standard relations. No priority-based performance-band enum is used, since goals can be below, equal to or above 100%.

Goal-bar presentation is opt-in via goal-bar. Its snapshot and SVG datasets expose active/failure/compression state; selector choices remain DOM configuration. Lifecycle choreography is proposed, not a new runtime state machine.
exclusions: Standalone landing/Drop-In/admin pages except surfaces embedded by Order Filler
Individual credential values, timestamps, numerical readings and cosmetic color/instrument choices
